name: Data Analyzer: About page offers a curl and a Python example for each of four API tasks
objective: Shows the About page's example list covers health check, version, file analysis and inline-data analysis, each in both curl (command line) and Python.
precondition: Example-building code only; no server needed.

steps.action: Build the list of examples for a made-up local address.
steps.expected: The ordered list of example names is exactly: health, version, analyze-file and analyze-json, each as a curl example and a Python example (8 entries).

name: Data Analyzer: Every About-page example has a name, title, language and non-empty code
objective: Shows no example is left blank or mislabelled.
precondition: Example-building code only; no server needed.

steps.action: Build the examples and inspect each one.
steps.expected: Each example has a non-empty id, title and code text, and its language is either bash or python.

name: Data Analyzer: About-page curl examples are one line so they paste cleanly
objective: Shows each curl example can be copied and pasted into a terminal in one go, with no line-continuation characters or trailing space.
precondition: Example-building code only; no server needed.

steps.expected: The code has no line break, no backslash-newline continuation and does not end with a space.

name: Data Analyzer: About-page Python examples need only the common 'requests' package
objective: Shows a user does not have to install anything unusual to run the Python examples.
precondition: Example-building code only; no server needed.

steps.action: Read the import lines of every Python example.
steps.expected: Every import is one of requests, os, json or sys, and no 'from ... import' line is used.

name: Data Analyzer: About-page examples use the server address given, with no placeholder left in
objective: Shows the examples are ready to run and do not contain leftover fill-in-the-blank text.
precondition: Example-building code only; no server needed.

steps.action: Build the examples for the made-up address and search each for the address and for placeholders.
steps.expected: Every example contains the address followed by /api/v1/ and contains no '<' character and no text 'YOUR_'.

name: Data Analyzer: A trailing slash on the server address does not produce a double slash
objective: Shows an address typed with a final '/' still gives correct example web addresses.
precondition: Example-building code only; no server needed.

steps.action: Build the examples for the address with a trailing slash.

name: Data Analyzer: A dangerous-looking server address is refused rather than put into a command
objective: Shows a server address containing quote marks and shell commands cannot be injected into a copy-and-paste command.
precondition: Example-building code only; no server needed.

steps.action: Try to build examples for an address that contains a quote, a semicolon and a delete command.
steps.expected: A ValueError (input rejected) is raised, so no example text is produced.

name: Data Analyzer: About-page examples never contain the real API key
objective: Shows secrets are not printed into text that users copy and share.
precondition: A real API server is started on the test machine's own local address only (no outside network), with a made-up API key set. The tests run the example text exactly as shown on the About page.

steps.action: Build the examples for the running local server and search each for the key value.
steps.expected: The key text does not appear in any example.

name: Data Analyzer: About-page examples refer to the key only by environment-variable name
objective: Shows users are told to supply the key through a named variable rather than by typing it into the example.
precondition: A real API server is started on the test machine's own local address only (no outside network), with a made-up API key set. The tests run the example text exactly as shown on the About page.

steps.action: Inspect each example that sends the X-API-Key header.
steps.data: Every curl and Python example that uses the key header
steps.expected: curl examples use the header value $DATA_ANALYZER_API_KEY; Python examples read os.environ["DATA_ANALYZER_API_KEY"]; no example uses os.getenv.

name: Data Analyzer: The example-building code does not read environment variables or use the web framework
objective: Shows the code that writes the examples cannot leak the key because it never touches the environment.
precondition: Source code of the example module available. This is a static check of the file's imports, not a run of it.

steps.action: Read the source of the example-building module and list what it imports.

name: Data Analyzer: About page on screen shows exactly the tested examples and never the key
objective: Shows what a user sees on the About page is the same text that is tested, and the secret key is not displayed.
precondition: Streamlit page tested headlessly with a made-up key and API address set. No network and no AI model.

steps.action: Open the About page headlessly (no browser window) with a made-up docker address and made-up key set in the environment.
steps.expected: The page runs without an error; the code blocks shown equal the examples built for the local address; a 'Use it from code (API)' heading is present.

steps.action: Search every code block and text block on the page for the key.
steps.expected: The key does not appear anywhere on the page.
